proposed_disposition.reason: The public isolated_verifier.verify_candidate API now accepts and successfully executes a complete materialized (rule! ...) program, so qualification-style exact replay no longer requires prototype authors to parse the wrapper. The exact requested persistent RacketBridge.apply_rule_program method is still absent, and the retained task-local verifier still imports private _program_body.
proposed_disposition.remaining_request: Only retain a smaller low-overhead batch-evaluation request for unlabeled grids/persistent bridges; document verify_candidate as the supported fail-closed path for labeled qualification.

retained_failure.root_cause: The first materialized parameter program relied on h and w that the canonical wrapper normally defines, but the verifier evaluated the stored rule body with only g bound.
